title: Developer III - Software Engineering
description:
**Role Description**
Job Title: Java Full Stack Developer Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack Developer with strong hands-on expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Microservices, and Cloud technologies. The ideal candidate should be able to design, develop, test, and deploy scalable web applications, working across both backend and frontend components. The role requires strong engineering fundamentals, experience building cloud-native applications, API integration, and familiarity with modern DevOps and CI/CD practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end applications using Java and Angular. Build scalable backend services and REST APIs using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot. Design and develop applications using Microservices architecture. Develop responsive and reusable frontend components using Angular, TypeScript, HTML, and CSS. Design and integrate RESTful APIs between frontend, backend, and external systems. Develop and deploy cloud-native applications, preferably on AWS. Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, exception handling, logging, and application security practices. Work with relational and/or NoSQL databases and implement efficient data-access solutions. Participate in application design, technical discussions, code reviews, and engineering decisions. Implement and support CI/CD pipelines for automated build, testing, and deployment. Use containerization technologies such as Docker and work with orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes, where applicable. Troubleshoot application, integration, and performance issues across frontend, backend, and cloud environments. Collaborate with Product, UX, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and other engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle. Follow software engineering best practices for code quality, security, maintainability, scalability, and performance. Leverage GenAI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Kiro, or equivalent AI coding assistants to improve developer productivity and accelerate software delivery. Use GenAI tools responsibly across the development lifecycle for code generation, refactoring, unit testing, debugging, documentation, and technical analysis. Apply appropriate engineering review, security, and coding standards when using AI-generated code. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 3 to 5 years of full stack development experience in Java and Angular tech stack Backend Development Strong hands-on experience with Java. Strong experience with Spring Framework and Spring Boot. Experience developing RESTful APIs and Microservices. Experience with Hibernate/JPA and database integration. Good understanding of object-oriented design, design patterns, exception handling, and application security. Frontend Development Strong hands-on experience with Angular and TypeScript. Good knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and responsive web development. Experience with component-based frontend architecture and state-management concepts. Experience integrating Angular applications with REST APIs. Microservices & Integration Hands-on experience designing and developing Microservices-based applications. Understanding of API design, service-to-service communication, authentication, logging, monitoring, and error handling. Familiarity with asynchronous processing, messaging, or event-driven architecture is desirable. GenAI-Assisted Software Development Hands-on experience using GenAI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, Kiro, or similar tools in day-to-day software development. Ability to effectively use AI-assisted development for Java, Spring Boot, Angular, Microservices, testing, and documentation. Good understanding of responsible AI-assisted development practices, including code review, security, quality validation, and protection of sensitive information. Good to Have Experience with Apigee or other API management/gateway platforms. Experience with Amazon Connect / IVR integrations. Exposure to Salesforce integrations. Experience working with legacy frontend technologies such as GWT. Experience with Redux or other state-management approaches. Experience with messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS messaging services. Knowledge of automated testing frameworks for backend and frontend applications. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to independently troubleshoot complex technical problems. Good communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Strong ownership and accountability for assigned deliverables. Ability to guide junior developers and contribute to technical discussions and code reviews. Education Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Primary Technology Stack Java | Spring Boot | Microservices | REST APIs | Angular | TypeScript | AWS/Azure/GCP | SQL/NoSQL | Git | CI/CD | Docker | Kubernetes | GenAI tool | Agentic AI
  
  
**Skills**
Agentic AI, Angular, Java, Spring Boot, AWS, CSS, TypeScript, SQL, Kubernetes, Microservices, Apigee

description:

We are looking for an experienced Java Developer to support the development, roll-out and global maintenance of our industrial Rich Client applications. * Develop and adopt roll-out strategies together with local IT responsibles.
* Integrate local legacy measuring equipment into existing systems.
* Analyze, troubleshoot, and optimize existing applications as part of the global 3rd-level support team.
* Implement new features in close collaboration with international business units and product management.
* Build and maintain automated build, test, and deployment pipelines (CI/CD).
* Perform security-focused code reviews and apply secure coding principles in development.
* Maintain and extend database structures including version control using tools such as Liquibase.
* Collaborate with globally distributed teams for operational support and incident handling

* Solid experience with Gradle as a build tool (similar Maven).
* Proficient with development and DevOps tools (like Jira, GitLab, CI/CD pipelines)
* Good understanding of relational databases, preferably Firebird (or comparable systems)
* Experience with ORM frameworks like Hibernate.
* Familiarity with database schema management tools such as Flyway.
* Experience with message brokers, especially RabbitMQ.
* Strong awareness of code quality and security, including:
* Secure Coding Principles (like Oracle Coding Standard for Java, OWASP best practices)
* Ideally, knowledge of industrial communication standards (like Modbus TCP, OPC / OPC UA)

description:

title: Software Engineer - Teamcenter Simulation Data Management
description:
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across a wide range of industries. From Formula 1 cars and skyscrapers to ships and space exploration vehicles, many of the products and innovations we encounter every day are designed and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are looking for a Software Engineer to develop and support Teamcenter solutions for simulation data management using modern software and web technologies.
  
  
In this role, you’ll design and implement technical solutions, contribute to new product functionality, and help maintain and enhance existing applications. You’ll work closely with colleagues across engineering, Product Validation, Technical Publications, and Release Management to deliver reliable, high-quality software.
  
  
You’ll also have opportunities to explore new technologies and technical approaches, contribute to longer-term engineering challenges, and continuously develop your expertise.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As a Software Engineer, you’ll develop and support Teamcenter solutions for simulation data management, working with technologies such as C++, React, JavaScript, and scripting languages. You’ll contribute to new product functionality while helping maintain and improve existing applications.
  
  
You’ll apply your technical expertise to solve complex engineering challenges, explore new approaches, and continuously improve software quality. This includes code reviews, testing, defect resolution, and developing tools and scripts that simplify development and support processes.
  
  
You’ll collaborate with developers, customers, and teams across Product Validation, Technical Publications, and Release Management to support product quality and timely delivery.
  
  
You’ll also:
  
  

* Contribute to technical planning, project scope, and delivery of key milestones.
* Create and maintain technical documentation and provide customer support when needed.
* Stay connected to relevant industry and academic developments, bringing useful new ideas and approaches into your work.

**What You’ll Bring**

* Strong proficiency in C++, with a good understanding of advanced software development concepts.
* Experience with JavaScript and modern web development technologies, such as React.
* Experience with at least one scripting language, such as Python, Shell, or Perl.
* Good understanding of object-oriented programming, design patterns, client-server architecture, and distributed systems.
* Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, AI-assisted development tools, or similar productivity technologies.
* Understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), software testing methodologies, and quality practices.
* Experience working with Agile development approaches, including Scrum.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly.
* Ability to organize and contribute to multiple complex projects and priorities.
* A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Professional software engineering experience that has prepared you to contribute effectively in this role.
* Ability to work effectively in a hybrid environment.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world.
  
  
You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!
  
  
**Our Benefits & Rewards**
The primary location for this opportunity is Pune, India.
  
  
This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation. The actual compensation offered is based on the successful candidate's job-related skills, experience, and relevant education/training. Siemens offers health and wellness benefits to employees; you can access the benefits available in your country via the link: https://jobs.sw.siemens.com/benefits/
  
  
This position may also be posted in additional locations beyond those specified above. For such locations, the applicable salary ranges and benefits will be disclosed by the Talent Acquisition Partner at the time of initial contact, in accordance with local legal requirements.
  
  
**Diversity & Inclusion**
We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from all talented individuals. At Siemens, we believe diverse perspectives drive innovation. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to succeed. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

description:
Roles & Responsibilities

We’re building a central Design Thinking function at Bajaj Finance - a team that will play a defining role as the organisation pivots into a direct-to-consumer company. This role sits at the intersection of data and human understanding, and thrives in that grey zone.

You’ll be the person who can stare at a funnel and see a human story. Who can sit with a field research readout and spot what’s missing. Who treats data not as an answer, but as a better question - and turns both into something the team can act on.

**What Your Work Looks Like-**

**You’ll operate across the Design Thinking lifecycle — from signal to solution:**

* Insight & Evidence: Journey analytics, Mining session replays, heatmaps, and behavioural data to surface where customers struggle and why. You bring statistical rigour — you know the difference between a pattern and noise, between correlation and causation, and you know when to trust the data and when to trust instinct.
* Challenge & Synthesis: You consume field research from dedicated research teams and stress-test it. You triangulate digital signals against qualitative findings, competitive benchmarks, and business metrics to build problem statements that hold up under scrutiny. You craft How Might We statements from clustered signals — framing the right questions that give the team a clear direction to solve against.
* Prototyping & Testing: You participate in solutioning — helping the team move from problem to prototype, designing tests, and closing the loop between what was hypothesised and what customers actually do.

**What Makes Someone Right for This-**

* 4–8 years in consumer insights, CX analytics, product analytics, UX research, or a similar role in B2C or consumer-facing companies, where you’ve worked across quantitative and qualitative inputs
* Comfortable in analytics platforms — session replay, web/app analytics, funnel analysis, segmented and cohort analysis. Can layer behavioural data over system-of-record data to move beyond surface-level insights. Specific tools matter less than your ability to get depth from any tool quickly
* Understands statistical thinking — hypothesis testing, significance, when to apply rigour and when to move on intuition
* Can read, challenge, and build on qualitative research even if you’re not the one conducting it — you know what good methodology looks like and can spot when a finding is thin
* Structures findings into clear, concise arguments. You’ve presented to senior stakeholders and know the difference between showing data and making a case
* Thinks in systems — you connect a drop-off at step 3 to an upstream design choice, a policy constraint, and a downstream business metric without being told to
* SQL-literate — you can pull what you need or speak to data teams in their language
* Brings critical reasoning that stress-tests assumptions rather than confirming them

Requirements

Ideal Candidate

* Strong Consumer Insights / CX Analytics / Product Insights profile (behavioral/user/product/UX analytics)
* Mandatory (Experience 1) - Must have 4+ years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) Analytics, Consumer Insights, Product Analytics, Behavioral Analytics, or UX Analytics, working on B2C digital products (Web/App) with a focus on understanding customer behavior, customer journeys, and experience improvement.
* Mandatory (Experience 2) - Must have hands-on experience analyzing customer journeys, behavioral funnels, digital interactions, session-level behavior, clickstream data, and experience metrics to identify pain points, drop-offs, and optimization opportunities.
* Mandatory (Experience 3) - Must have experience using CX and Digital Experience Analytics platforms such as Medallia, ContentSquare, Google Analytics (GA4) or similar tools for customer behavior analysis, journey mapping, and insight generation.
* Mandatory (Experience 4) - Must have experience working closely with Product, Design, CX, Business, Marketing, and Research teams to generate insights, validate hypotheses, and drive customer experience improvements.
* Mandatory (Experience 5 ) - Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction, querying, analysis, exploratory data analysis, automation, and behavioral data interpretation. Ability to independently analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and generate actionable business insights.
* Mandatory (Experience 6): Understanding of hypothesis-driven thinking and basic experimentation/A/B testing concepts, including interpreting results and distinguishing between correlation and causation.
* Preferred ( Experience 1) - Candidates from product-based companies (B2C preferred) OR Data Analytics Service companies like Mu Sigma etc

Experience: 3–6 years · Work from office · 5 days a week + alternate Saturdays · Notice period up to 30 days

Benefits

More than 250 manufacturers rely on our ICyte Platform to orchestrate their commercial and government payer contracting, patient services, and distribution channels. ICyte is the first and only platform that unites the financial, operational, and commercial data sets required to support therapy access in the era of specialty and precision medicine. With ICyte, Life Sciences innovators can digitalize their market access operations, freeing up resources to focus on more data-driven decision support. We are headquartered in Philadelphia, PA (USA), with offices in: Ambler, PA (USA); Pune, India; and Medellín, Colombia. For more information, visit www.integrichain.com, or follow us on Twitter @IntegriChain and LinkedIn.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Your mission at IntegriChain:**
Gross-to-Net is the gap between a drug’s list price and the net revenue a manufacturer realizes after rebates, chargebacks, discounts, and fees. Grss-to-Net is central to how pharmaceutical companies forecast, report, and plan.
  
  
As a GTN Analyst II, you will support multiple external clients by reconciling transactional data, validating pricing calculations, explaining variances, and producing the reports they rely on to meet contractual deadlines. You will work across our GTN systems and Excel, partner with colleagues in Pune and remote teams in the U.S. and build expertise in pharmaceutical revenue management.
  
  
**Working hours:**
This is a hybrid role based in Pune. Because you will work closely with U.S.-based clients and managers, the role requires some overlap with U.S. Eastern working hours
  
  
**What you’ll do to thrive in this role:**

* Data and reconciliation

+ Gather client transactional data, reconcile it to the general ledger, and load it into the source system.
+ Identify and resolve errors in the GTN system according to defined business rules, applying corrections as needed.
+ Monitor and review system output for consistency, accuracy, and formatting.

* Reporting and delivery

+ Produce client deliverables and reports from system results and explain the variances behind them.
+ Meet contractual SLAs by planning and prioritizing your workload around fixed deadlines.
+ Escalate issues promptly when they fall outside defined business rules or put a deadline at risk.

* Process and collaboration

+ Keep process documentation and work instructions current and aligned with RACI standards.
+ Build strong working relationships with internal colleagues and remote team members across multiple locations.

**Where You’ll Grow:**

* As you build confidence in the core role, you will cross-train in adjacent areas of Net Revenue and Compliance, as appliable:
* Government Pricing (GP): transactional and master data, GL reconciliations, and data extraction across client, internal, and external systems, fundamentals including Class of Trade (COT), PHS 340B validation, and monthly pricing calculations.
* State Price Transparency Reporting (SPTR): reporting requirements and the U.S. state regulations behind them: portfolio setup, reporting activities, and preparation of client deliverables.

**Qualifications**
**What you’ll bring to the table:**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Commerce, Information Management, or another business discipline.
* 2–4 years of experience in financial analysis, reporting, accounting, or a related field.
* Experience producing financial reports, with strong Excel skills (e.g., pivot tables, lookups, and large datasets) and working knowledge of MS Office.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including comfort working with large data volumes and complex financial models.
* Sharp attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy in data and reporting.
* A process-oriented, organized approach to planning work across multiple client accounts.
* Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to collaborate with cross-functional and U.S.-based teams.
* Ability to pick up new software and systems quickly.
* Initiative to support value add projects and drive process improvements

**Nice to have**

* Experience in the pharmaceutical or healthcare industry.
* Working knowledge of Managed Care, Medicaid, GPO contracting, or Government Pricing.

title: AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
description:
Embark on a transformative journey as
**“**
AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation
**”**
at Barclays, where you’ll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You’ll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
You will join the Business Banking transformation team, which shapes future-state operating models and redesigns end-to-end customer and colleague journeys. Working across Operations, Product, Technology, Risk, Compliance and Customer Experience, the team turns strategic designs into practical transformation roadmaps that simplify processes, strengthen controls and enable sustainable digital change.
  
  
**Skills**
To be successful in this role as a “AVP - Journey Excellence and Optimisation”, you should possess the following skillsets:
  
  
**Target Operating Model Design**

* Lead the development and evolution of Target Operating Models across Business Banking customer and operational journeys.
* Conduct current-state assessments to understand existing processes, customer and colleague pain points, operating structures, technology dependencies, controls and performance.
* Define future-state operating-model components across people, process, technology, data, controls, governance and performance management.
* Develop clear design principles to guide future-state structures, service models and ways of working.
* Define roles, responsibilities, capabilities, interaction models, governance arrangements and decision rights required to support the target state.
* Ensure proposed operating models are practical, scalable and aligned with Business Banking priorities, customer needs and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Maintain traceability between identified business problems, design decisions, proposed changes and intended outcomes.

**Customer and Colleague Journey Transformation**

* Lead the assessment and redesign of end-to-end customer and colleague journeys across areas such as onboarding, servicing, lending, Customer Due Diligence and case management.
* Apply customer-centred design principles to simplify journeys, reduce avoidable friction and improve customer and colleague outcomes.
* Facilitate journey-mapping and design workshops with operational teams, subject-matter experts and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Identify process gaps, failure points, unnecessary hand-offs, duplication, delays and control weaknesses.
* Translate complex operational challenges into simplified, scalable and digitally enabled future-state journeys.
* Ensure journey designs appropriately consider different customer needs, servicing requirements and risk profiles.
* Establish appropriate measures to assess the impact of journey changes on customer experience, service quality, turnaround time and operational performance.

**Process Optimisation and Continuous Improvement**

* Apply appropriate process-improvement methodologies to assess and redesign end-to-end processes.
* Develop current-state and future-state process maps, service blueprints and supporting design documentation.
* Identify opportunities to remove process debt, reduce manual activity, simplify hand-offs and improve first-time-right outcomes.
* Use operational data, customer insight and colleague feedback to identify root causes and prioritise improvement opportunities.
* Assess opportunities to improve productivity, create capacity and strengthen process resilience.
* Embed continuous-improvement principles within future-state processes and operating models.
* Support the identification, validation, measurement and tracking of transformation benefits.

**Digital, Automation and AI Enablement**

* Identify and assess opportunities to use digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI within Business Banking journeys.
* Work with Product and Technology partners to translate business requirements into appropriate digital and technology capabilities.
* Support the assessment of technology feasibility, business value, operational impact and control implications.
* Ensure that proposed technology solutions are integrated into the wider operating model rather than implemented as isolated process changes.
* Contribute to the design and implementation of workflow, case-management and AI-enabled servicing solutions.
* Promote responsible adoption of technology, with appropriate consideration of governance, data, customer outcomes, operational resilience and controls.

**Transformation Planning and Delivery**

* Translate agreed target-state designs into structured and executable delivery roadmaps.
* Define delivery phases, dependencies, business readiness requirements, risks, assumptions and intended outcomes.
* Support the development of business cases, investment proposals and governance submissions.
* Partner with change and delivery teams to transition designs from concept through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.
* Provide design oversight during delivery to ensure that implemented changes remain aligned with agreed target-state principles.
* Identify and manage design risks, dependencies and issues, escalating where appropriate.
* Support pilot, test-and-learn and phased implementation approaches where these are appropriate.
* Monitor delivery progress, benefit realisation and adoption against agreed measures.
* Produce clear updates, recommendations and decision papers for senior stakeholders and governance forums.

**Risk and Control**

* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work performed.
* Ensure target operating models and journey designs appropriately consider regulatory requirements, operational risk, customer outcomes, data, privacy and control effectiveness.
* Identify potential risks and control impacts arising from process, technology, organisational or operating-model changes.
* Engage Risk, Compliance, Legal and Control stakeholders at the appropriate stages of design and delivery.
* Ensure key controls, accountabilities, governance arrangements and escalation routes are clearly reflected in the future-state design.
* Support completion of relevant risk assessments, governance reviews and approvals.
* Escalate material design, delivery or control concerns through the appropriate governance channels.
* Ensure all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, the Enterprise Risk Management Framework and applicable internal Barclays policies and standards.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills Include**

* Experience identifying and evaluating opportunities across digital workflow, automation, process mining, analytics, artificial intelligence and generative AI, including consideration of business value, operational impact, governance and controls.
* Experience developing business cases, benefits assessments, executive papers and senior-management updates, and providing design oversight through mobilisation, implementation and embedding.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
This role is based in our Pune office.

To collaborate with stakeholders and use data and MI to identify process optimisation opportunities for capacity creation in relevant business areas.

**Primary Focus: Frontend Development and Technical Leadership**

* Experience designing secure, observable, and testable AI-enabled enterprise applications.
